text: Nykaa offers fast delivery—usually within just 3 days—which is impressive. The products are genuine and of good quality, and there are often great discounts available. However, the only drawback is their return and exchange policy. There's no proper return option, and exchanges can be difficult, which makes it a bit inconvenient if something doesn’t work out. Otherwise, a reliable platform for beauty and skincare shopping.
author: Gopika Unnikrishnan

text: My experience with my last few orders has been extremely disappointing. Almost every order I placed was eventually cancelled. Some products were initially supposed to be delivered the next day, but they were delayed for 8–9 days and then cancelled altogether. After making me wait for so long, the products were still not delivered. This has been happening quite frequently recently, and it is extremely frustrating and disappointing.
author: Megha Sardar
